title: Grateful Dead Live at Pirates World on 1970-03-24
source: flac16/48kHz; Source: Soundboard > Master Reel > Cassette > Dat (48k)

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording praised for its crisp clarity, capturing a fiery Dark Star → Other One stretch and solid early‑70s psychedelic jams.
ai_review.review: The sbd source is described as “top notch” and even “crispy,” indicating a clean, well‑balanced capture. Reviewers highlight the high‑energy Dark Star/Other One sequence along with classic numbers like St. Stephen and Not Fade Away, though comments are scattered and overall sentiment is mixed.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive remarks about sound quality and several standout songs offset by vague, low‑rated and disjointed feedback; limited number of reviews yields moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note "top notch" and "crispy" sound with no reported drop‑outs or distortion; overall a clear, well‑mixed capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A rapid‑fire, mojo‑filled set that jumps between keys and moods, delivering classic psychedelic peaks despite a somewhat rambling description.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s urgent lead on The Other One is specifically praised.
